curated.lethality_detail_zh: 经血液、不安全注射及母婴等途径传播，急性感染约55%–85%转为慢性；隐匿进展15–30年可导致肝硬化、终末期肝病及肝细胞癌。全球年死亡逾23.9万人。
curated.treatability_summary_zh: 人类传染病史上的彻底突破：全口服泛基因型直接抗病毒药物（DAA，如索磷布韦维磷他韦“丙通沙”）仅需8–12周规范服药即可使95%–99%以上患者实现持续病毒学应答（SVR12），即彻底病毒学根治治愈，且已纳入中国常规药品保障谈判目录。

curated.lethality_detail_zh: 伤寒沙门菌引发的全身性发热疾病，若未及时有效抗菌治疗，常在病程第2–3周发生致命性回肠末端穿孔（急性腹膜炎）或肠道大出血，并发穿孔者全球病死率仍达8%–20%以上。
curated.treatability_summary_zh: 及时使用敏感抗生素（如三代头孢或阿奇霉素，避开高耐药喹诺酮类）绝大多数可完全治愈；但多重耐药（MDR）与广泛耐药（XDR）菌株正在全球扩散。

clinical_management.acute_emergency_protocol_zh: 120一分钟识别与避坑：持续高热1–2周（梯形热、相对缓脉）、淡漠嗜睡的伤寒患者，若突然出现右下腹/全腹剧烈刀割样痛、腹肌僵硬（肠穿孔信号）或大量便血、面色苍白血压骤降（肠出血信号），立即拨打120！严禁进食喝水、严禁服用泻药或强效止痛药；急诊立即禁食补液、静脉广谱抗生素并急诊外科手术修补穿孔。

non_drug_therapies_zh: 严格消化道隔离，病愈后需连续粪便培养阴性方可解除隔离（防慢性胆囊带菌者持续传播）

master.definition_en: An autoimmune disease that affects the lungs and kidneys and is characterized by pulmonary alveolar hemorrhage (bleeding in the lungs) and a kidney disease known as glomerulonephritis. Some use the term 'Goodpasture syndrome' for the findings of glomerulonephritis and pulmonary hemorrhage and the term 'Goodpasture disease' for those patients with glomerulonephritis, pulmonary hemorrhage, and anti-GBM antibodies. Currently, the preferred term for both conditions is “ anti-GBM antibody disease ”. Circulating antibodies are directed against the collagen of the part of the kidney known as the glomerular basement membrane (GBM), resulting in acute or rapidly progressive glomerulonephritis. Antibodies also attack the collagen of the air sacs of the lung (alveoli) resulting in bleeding of the lung (pulmonary hemorrhage). Symptoms may include general body discomfort or pain, bleeding from the nose and/or blood in the urine, respiratory problems, anemia, chest pain, and kidney failure. Anti-GBM disease is thought to result from an environmental insult (smoking, infections, exposure to certain drugs) in a person with genetic susceptibility, such as a specific human leukocyte antigen (HLA) type. Diagnosis is confirmed with the presence of anti-GBM antibody in the blood or in the kidney. The treatment of choice is plasmapheresis in conjunction with prednisone and cyclophosphamide.
synonyms_en: rapidly progressive glomerulonephritis with pulmonary haemorrhage
rapidly progressive glomerulonephritis with pulmonary hemorrhage

master.definition_en: Tularemia is an infection caused by the bacterium Francisella tularensis. It is more common in rodents and rabbits but has been found in other animals including domestic cats, sheep, birds, and hamsters. Humans can become infected in several different ways: by handling infected animals, through tick or deer fly bites, by drinking contaminated water, or by inhaling contaminated dust or aerosols. Person-to-person transmission has not been reported. The type of tularemia and the particular signs and symptoms vary depending on how the bacteria enter the body. However, fever is seen in most cases. Though tularemia can be life-threatening, most infections can be treated with antibiotics.

master.definition_en: Levator syndrome is characterized by sporadic pain in the rectum caused by spasm of a muscle near the anus (the levator ani muscle). The muscle spasm causes pain that typically is not related to defecation. The pain usually lasts less than 20 minutes. Pain may be brief and intense or a vague ache high in the rectum. It may occur spontaneously or with sitting and can waken a person from sleep. The pain may feel as if it would be relieved by the passage of gas or a bowel movement. In severe cases, the pain can persist for many hours and can recur frequently. A person may have undergone various unsuccessful rectal operations to relieve these symptoms.

breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 在数分钟至数小时黄金窗到来前，提前发出异常信号
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 以遗传性易栓症、急性肺栓塞、主动脉夹层、恶性心律失常和脑出血为代表的急症，平时毫无征兆，往往在睡梦中或静息状态下几分钟内危及生命——家人根本来不及反应。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 需要发展连续无创可穿戴微循环/血氧/心电多模态传感器、血液微凝血活性快速试纸，结合 AI 在异常触发前几小时识别微血栓与高危信号并立即叫醒预警。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 时序多模态生理异常检测 + 血液高凝状态前置生物标志物发现 + 低成本家系表型筛查算法。

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 急诊极危重期的快速再通与器官细胞保护
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 把“几分钟决定生死”的抢救窗口拓宽成“几小时可救回”
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 对急性心梗、脑梗死、脓毒性休克、急性肝衰竭与热射病而言，哪怕送到急诊室，微血管再灌注损伤、细胞因子风暴和不可逆线粒体坏死仍会在短时间内夺走生命。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 研发免复杂配型的超快精准溶栓与导管微取栓器械、阻断微血栓级联炎症风暴药物，以及在缺血缺氧期守住心肌与脑神经元存活的细胞保护剂。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 急性多器官微循环级联动力学建模、急诊快速炎症/凝血表型分型、老药新用紧急器官保护筛选。

master.definition_en: A rare genetic systemic disease characterized by adult onset, progressive sensorimotor and autonomic neuropathy and infiltrative cardiomyopathy. Neurological involvement usually starts with sensory loss in the extremities and progresses with motor neuropathy. Cardiomyopathy presents with rhythm abnormalities and heart failure. The disease also frequently manifests with a range of additional clinical signs and symptoms due to associated ocular, renal, central nervous system and gastrointestinal involvement.
